sizeAdjustedEncounter.name: Size-Adjusted Encounter Level
sizeAdjustedEncounter.hint: When enabled, each opposition creature's encounter level shifts by its size step minus the party's average size step (Tiny=0 … Gargantuan=5; Small PCs count as Medium when Treat Small Player Characters as Medium is on; ties round toward Medium). Falls back to Medium if no PCs are found. Does not change actor sheet levels. Patches apply only while this is on; lib-wrapper is recommended but not required.

encounter.libWrapperRecommended: Size-Adjusted Encounter Level is active without lib-wrapper. It works, but installing lib-wrapper is recommended for better compatibility with other modules.
